# OVOSKG Clothings

Official website: https://ovoskgclothings.com/

OVOSKG Clothings is a Nigerian bespoke clothing company based in Ife, Osun State. It creates bespoke suits for men and women, luxury men's kaftans and other custom garments.

## Primary pages
- Collections: https://ovoskgclothings.com/collections
- Start a bespoke order: https://ovoskgclothings.com/bespoke
- Virtual measurements: https://ovoskgclothings.com/measurements
- Order tracking: https://ovoskgclothings.com/track
- Company story: https://ovoskgclothings.com/about
- Contact: https://ovoskgclothings.com/contact

## Business facts
- Business registration: BN 3795532
- Base: Ife, Osun State, Nigeria
- Services: men's bespoke suits, women's bespoke suits, luxury men's kaftans, custom clothing, remote measurement review, physical fittings, order tracking
- Public social profile: https://www.instagram.com/ovoskg_clothings/

For current policies and ordering information, use the official pages on ovoskgclothings.com rather than third-party summaries.
